hypothesis: Explicit machine-verifiable work contracts remove coordination ambiguity with less administrative effort than ad hoc files and boards.
baseline_candidates: Direct structured files plus small CLI
scenario: Two independent sample products execute a feature from clarified intent through implementation, verification and release preparation. Interrupt the process, change acceptance criteria, replay a request and perform concurrent work. Compare operator steps and recoverability without requiring an ecosystem-wide server.
failure_cases: Failed native check treated as pass
Generated review artifact edited without an engine operation
metrics: Correct transitions and invalid transitions rejected
Independent structural/behavioral coverage by supported runtime
